Name: Forecaster Texts - TV Weather Luck and Calendar reminders
Author: TheElm
Description:
[size=5][u][b]Description[/b][/u][/size]

[b]Forecaster Texts[/b] is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] mod that makes mornings a breeze! Don't stop and check the TV, just receive your alerts using the modern power of text messages!

[size=3][b]Chat Alerts:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Pelican Town weather
[*]Ginger Island weather
[*]Fortune teller
[*]Cooking channel
[*]Birthday reminders [i](Disabled by default)[/i]
[/list]
[size=5][u][b]Installation[/b][/u][/size]

[b]Installing[/b]
- Ensure that you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] installed
- Unzip the latest version into your "[code]~\Mods[/code]" Folder

[b]Uninstalling[/b]
- Delete the "[code]ForecasterText[/code]" folder from your "[code]~\Mods[/code]" Folder

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
Should work no problem for all players in a multiplayer game

[size=5][u][b]Config[/b][/u][/size]
The [code]config.json[/code] file can be used to change the mod options. Directly changing the file requires restarting the game.

The mod supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make configuring the mod easier.

[size=3][b]Config Options:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]When to show [b]Pelican Town[/b] weather: (Always, raining, not raining, never)
[*]When to show [b]Ginger Island[/b] weather: (Always, raining, not raining, never)
[*]Whether to show [b]Birthdays[/b]
[*]Which [b]Luck[/b] to show: (Good luck, neutral luck, bad luck)
[*]Whether to show [b]cooking recipes[/b]
[*]The alert [b]emojis[/b] to use
[/list]

[size=5][u][b]Supported Mods[/b][/u][/size]
These mods are [i]Optional[/i] but are supported by Forecaster Texts
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23868]Nature Wonders[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url]
[/list]

[size=5][u][b]Source[/b][/u][/size]
The source code for 'Forecaster Texts' is available on [url=https://github.com/GStefanowich/SDV-Forecaster]GitHub[/url]
